environment.description: AWS Step Functions workflow with parallel branches invoking the worker-service via HTTP task integration. The worker runs as a Kubernetes pod in namespace 'processing' on EKS. The Step Functions state machine has two parallel branches: one sends action='process' and the other sends action='cleanup' for the same buffer_ref. No service mesh is deployed. The worker pod accepts traffic from any source. Step Functions retry policy with maxAttempts=3 and backoffRate=1.0 means rapid retries can trigger the double-free race condition.
